{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nhar'qual Rift''' was one of the largest rifts in the [[Adsila Rifts]]. Rumored to be bottomless, probes registered a depth of at least four hundred and fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] before contact was lost. "Nhar'qual" translated to "dark death" in [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]], and for a time it was used as an execution site for criminals. Members of the [[Black Bha'lir]] gathered at the Nhar'qual Rift to settle disputes among its members.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
